nodes.question: What was the primary objective of the research on juvenile COTS?
nodes.answer: The primary objective was to quantify ontogenetic changes in various traits of juvenile COTS and explore their potential as indicators of age.

nodes.question: What do the models mentioned in the paragraph allow regarding age-trait relationships?
nodes.answer: The models do not constrain age-trait relationships to pre-specified parametric shapes, allowing the data to determine the shape of the response curve.
